answer.rationale: Broadly roll out streamlined self-serve onboarding for SMBs rather than matching the competitor’s discount. Signup simplification produced a durable SMB activation lift, and shortened onboarding improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. Targeted discounting drove acquisition but materially reduced 30-day retention, creating unacceptable long-term qualified-revenue risk despite the immediate competitive pressure. The churn effect of onboarding changes is not directly established, so monitor SMB churn and qualified revenue closely.
